question: Should this PR be narrowed to a separately scoped interim safeguard, or redesigned to satisfy the canonical issue’s cross-file provenance and exact-pricing requirements?
rationale: The repository owner explicitly retained the canonical issue after reverting a file-local approach, while this PR again proposes file-local containment with intentional undercounting.

options.title: Redesign for canonical fix
options.body: Implement scan-wide fork and event provenance with exact token and pricing validation before claiming to fix the linked issue.

options.title: Narrow to interim safeguard
options.body: Remove the canonical close claim and merge only with explicit owner approval of the documented temporary undercount policy.

options.title: Close this approach
options.body: Close the PR if adapting it to the cross-file design would require replacing most of the proposed implementation.

recommendation.title: Redesign for canonical fix
recommendation.body: Implement scan-wide fork and event provenance with exact token and pricing validation before claiming to fix the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner supplied the current architecture and proof requirements after reverting the previous candidate.
